title: Output of the prompt-voix agent: a voice's instruction

instruction.description: (English) Prose, one paragraph: identity, origin (native language named), prosody, state. Includes the held physical constraint if the character carries one. No negation, no recording words, no accent words.

refText.description: (Language of the dialogues, `langueDesDialogues`) The voice's listening line, which is its reference text: 2 or 3 complete sentences (at least 2), first person, in the character's manner, factual with no stakes. The reference voice reads it word for word.
